scope: x86_64 UEFI Arch Linux installer — preview is non-destructive

requirements.requirement: Reidentify each selected device and prohibit writes to live or ambiguous targets
requirements.evidence_required: Host-exclusion VM tests, identity swap and active mount fault injection

requirements.requirement: Require one-use authorization for each destructive target using displayed stable identities
requirements.evidence_required: Consent bypass tests and reviewed execution-manifest log

requirements.requirement: Separate pure planning and privileged execution across explicit allowlisted structured operations
requirements.evidence_required: Executor interface review, exploit tests, operation allowlist

requirements.requirement: Use LUKS2 and separate per-volume offline recovery credentials without logging secrets
requirements.evidence_required: Recovery drills, masked logs, crash tests

requirements.requirement: Use signed boot assets and verified TPM2 PIN policy where supported, with independent recovery
requirements.evidence_required: Signed UKI tamper, kernel update, PCR mismatch and TPM-loss tests

requirements.requirement: Delegate Wi-Fi credential entry to trusted tools and require explicit opt-in before live changes
requirements.evidence_required: Mocked subprocess and consent tests; real hardware qualifications

requirements.requirement: Require verified source provenance, pinned CI actions, signed distribution and vetted package dependencies
requirements.evidence_required: CI configuration checks, reproducibility and signature verification

requirements.requirement: Make every security claim evidence-backed with FAILED, UNVERIFIED and SKIPPED support
requirements.evidence_required: Structured report tests proving no unexecuted control is labelled PASSED

requirements.requirement: Preserve active remote administration through scoped firewall changes and watchdog rollback
requirements.evidence_required: Remote lockout simulation, IPv6/DHCP/DNS/VR traffic tests

requirements.requirement: Apply only supported, reversible tuning without reducing mandatory protections
requirements.evidence_required: Benchmark and regression comparisons, rollback verification

requirements.requirement: Never write TPM PIN, LUKS secret, signing private key or live credential into ordinary logs or reports
Reject a production-ready claim until independent review, real recovery and supported hardware qualification pass
requirements.evidence_required: Human signoff and linked immutable test artifacts
